ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given that the length of segment $AB=15\text{cm}$, and point $C$ is on segment $AB$ with $AC:CB=3:2$. Find the lengths of segments $AC$ and $CB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=15\text{cm}$, and the ratio of $AC$ to $CB$ is $3:2$,

it follows that $AC=\frac{3}{3+2}AB=\frac{3}{5}\times 15=\boxed{9\text{cm}}$, and $CB=\frac{2}{3+2}AB=\frac{2}{5}\times 15=\boxed{6\text{cm}}$;
